name: Rejection Reason 71 Code
definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction/cancellation request has a rejected status.

ADEA.name: Account Servicer Deadline Missed
ADEA.definition: Transaction/instruction received after the account servicer's specified deadline.

SAFE.name: Safekeeping Account Rejection
SAFE.definition: Unrecognised or invalid message sender's safekeeping account.

NRGM.name: No Match
NRGM.definition: More than one instruction match the criteria.

REFE.name: Reference Rejection
REFE.definition: Instruction has a reference identical to another previously received instruction.
